text: Binary per-row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parsed; order irrelevant): returns 1 if every comment relies solely on abstract normative principles (general claims about what is right, fair, just or ought to be), with no concrete factual examples, personal experiences or details. Returns 0 if the list is non-empty and at least one comment contains any concrete, personal or empirical-example content. Returns null if the list is empty or OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution text and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and is judged like other content.
